hook: Tripathi has spent his career on the unglamorous but consequential work of making health data actually move between systems, first from the policy side as the U.S. government's top health IT official, and now from inside a leading hospital system, applying that same interoperability and governance discipline to how AI gets deployed in clinical care.
name: Micky Tripathi

quote.text: Trust in AI in health care will be earned through transparency, not assumed through technology.
quote.context: A recurring theme in Tripathi's public remarks and ONC policy statements on health AI transparency, 2023-2024

moniker: Federal Architect of Health AI Policy

Micky Tripathi, official bio, Mayo Clinic Newsroom

timeline.impact: Early regional health information exchange built

timeline.event: Confirmed as National Coordinator for Health IT
timeline.impact: Becomes the federal government's top health-technology policy official

timeline.event: ONC finalizes the HTI-1 rule on AI transparency
timeline.impact: First federal transparency mandate for clinical AI algorithms
Moves federal AI-governance experience into direct health-system deployment

quick_facts: Served as National Coordinator for Health Information Technology (ONC) under HHS, 2021-2024
Led federal rulemaking on health data interoperability and AI transparency in certified health IT
Now Chief Artificial Intelligence Implementation Officer at Mayo Clinic
Previously led the Massachusetts eHealth Collaborative and CRICO

achievements.title: National Coordinator for Health IT, HHS/ONC (2021-2024)
achievements.impact: Led the federal office setting national policy for electronic health records, interoperability standards, and, later in his tenure, transparency requirements for AI used in certified health IT.

achievements.title: HTI-1 rule on AI transparency in health IT (2024)
achievements.impact: Under his leadership, ONC finalized the first federal rule requiring transparency disclosures for predictive AI algorithms embedded in certified electronic health record systems.

achievements.title: Leading the Massachusetts eHealth Collaborative
achievements.impact: Built one of the earliest large-scale regional health information exchange efforts in the U.S. before his federal role.

achievements.title: Chief AI Implementation Officer, Mayo Clinic
achievements.impact: Brings federal AI-governance experience directly into deployment decisions at one of the country's leading health systems.
